### Standalone installation

Install the latest version of operetta-compose from PyPI, e.g. using [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```bash
uv pip install operetta-compose
```

The `spot_detection` task additionally needs [Spotiflow](https://github.com/weigertlab/spotiflow) (which pulls in torch). Install it via the `spotiflow` extra:

```bash
uv pip install "operetta-compose[spotiflow]"
```


### Fractal installation

From a [Fractal](https://fractal-analytics-platform.github.io/) server collect the package from PyPI with `operetta-compose` and indicate the desired version number.
